headings: (500 ML) ORCHIDÉE LUMIÈRE HAND AND BODY CREAM

jsonld_raw.name: (500 ML) ORCHIDÉE LUMIÈRE HAND AND BODY CREAM
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented hand and body cream. Comes in a container with a dispenser.

Orchidée Lumière | Orchid flowers exude a sensual and mysterious fragrance with hints of black vanilla that envelope an elegant floral bouquet, adding a final touch of rich warmth.

Notes:
Top notes: citrus cocktail, Italian lemon oil, fruity.
Heart: orchid, Egyptian jasmine, lily of the valley, freesia, gardenia.
Base notes: cedar wood, cedar oil, musk, vanilla.
